notes.title: Patch Notes 1.1.0
notes.content:
[h3][b][u]Changes:[/u][/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Corrected subtitles in: Russian, France, Japan, and Polish
[*] Fixed issues related to graphic settings
[*] Fixed issues with audio and visuals
[*] Fixed bugs related to flickering and collision issues
[*] Fixed journal bugs
[*] Updated environment lights
[*] Updated intro and trailer of full versions
[/list]

[u][h3][b]New Features:[/b][/h3][/u]

[list]
[*] Added support to Dualshock 4 controller
[/list]

notes.title: Free prologue to “The Last Show of Mr. Chardish“ available on September 3rd
notes.content:
Hi guys! 

The free prologue “The Last Show of Mr. Chardish“ is coming on [b]September 3rd 2020[/b]!

Prologue’s title is: “The Last Show of Mr. Chardish: Act I" and it’s an introduction to the game's world and history. In a game you’ll meet the main character, Actress Ella, and help her solve first secrets about Robert Chardish

On the occasion of the release we've planned a [b]second livestream[/b] of “The Last Show of Mr. Chardish: Act I" with developers. 

[h3]Join us [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1397140)]HERE[/url]
on 3rd September 3rd 2020 at
11AM PST, 2PM EDT, 8PM CEST.[/h3]

Remember that a [b]live chat[/b] will be available through the whole stream, so you can ask any game related questions.

We can’t wait to hear what you all think!

See ya! 

[i]Punk Notion and Hydra Games [/i]

notes.content:
Hi guys! 

We are pleased to announce that TODAY at 8pm (CEST) at Gamescom you can watch our [b]first gameplay of “The Last Show of Mr. Chardish: Act 1” with developers[/b]. It’s the opportunity to exclusively see the prologue of our game, [b]before the release[/b]!

Quick reminder: "The Last Show of Mr. Chardish: Act I" is a prologue to the full version of "The Last Show of Mr. Chardish" and is an [b]introduction to the game's world and its history[/b].

[h3]Join us [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1397140)]HERE[/url]
[b]TODAY[/b]
at [b]11AM PST, 2PM EDT, 8PM CEST[/b][/h3]
